home.subtitle: Start everyday office work, inspect current tasks, and manage the information your assistant can use.
home.startHint: Choose an example to place a complete instruction in the task box. Nothing runs until you send it.

reimbursement.title: Prepare a reimbursement package
reimbursement.prompt: Organize the attached invoices and receipts into a reimbursement checklist. Flag missing dates, amounts, categories, or approvals, and create a clear summary for me to review before submission.

requirements.title: Turn notes into requirements
requirements.prompt: Turn the attached notes into a requirements document with goals, users, scope, acceptance criteria, open questions, and risks. Mark every assumption and do not invent missing facts.

data.title: Analyze a data file
data.prompt: Analyze the attached spreadsheet. Check data quality first, then summarize key changes, unusual values, and conclusions supported by the data. Create a concise table of findings.

market.title: Prepare a market brief
market.prompt: Prepare a market brief for the topic I provide. Separate sourced facts from inference, compare the main alternatives, and list the evidence and dates behind each important conclusion.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.subtitle: These are your real conversations and their current state.
tasks.manageHint: Open a task to inspect its messages and state. Stop an active run, add files, or amend requirements in the conversation so the existing execution and history controls are preserved.

status.resourceUpdatePending: Capability updates are queued until the current task finishes. Existing authorized capabilities remain available.
status.resourceCheckDeferred: Capability updates could not be checked. Existing authorized capabilities remain available; a check will run later.

errors.noCapability: No work capabilities are authorized for this account. Contact an administrator.
errors.prepareFailed: The work environment could not be prepared ({{code}}). Retry, or contact an administrator if it persists.

files.title: Files
files.subtitle: Browse task, personal, shared, and generated files with their saved versions.
files.restoreConfirm: Restore {{name}} to the version saved at {{time}}?
files.warnings: {{count}} files could not be fully read or versioned. Refresh and review the list.
files.diffTruncated: This file is long. Only the first 1,000 lines are shown.
files.continuePrompt: Continue working with the workspace file "{{path}}". Read and confirm its current content first, then apply my next instruction. Save a new file or version instead of overwriting the original unless I explicitly ask.
files.officePreviewHint: 브라우저에서는 현재 이 Office 파일의 인라인 미리보기를 지원하지 않습니다. 작업에서 파일을 읽거나 계속 처리할 수 있으며, 원본 파일을 다운로드해 확인할 수도 있습니다.
files.unsupportedPreviewHint: 이 파일 형식은 여기에서 안전하게 미리 볼 수 없습니다. 원본 파일을 다운로드하세요.

knowledge.title: Knowledge
knowledge.subtitle: Upload source material, follow indexing results, search original passages, and inspect exact versions.
knowledge.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}} and revoke it from future use?
knowledge.empty: Choose a knowledge base or add its first document

issues.fileType: This file type is not supported. Upload a PDF, Office file, image, Markdown, text, CSV, or JSON file.
issues.invalidDocument: This document could not be read. Re-export it from its source application, then upload the new copy.
issues.utf8: Save this text file as UTF-8, then upload it again.
issues.noText: No searchable text was found. Upload a text-based copy or an OCR-processed version.
issues.tooLarge: This document exceeds an indexing limit. Split or reduce the file, then upload the smaller parts.
issues.ocrUnavailable: OCR for this document is unavailable. Upload a text-based copy or ask an administrator to enable the required OCR language.
issues.contentChanged: The stored file changed before reindexing. Upload it as a new version to keep the version history accurate.
issues.temporary: Document extraction could not finish. Retry once; if it repeats, re-export the file or contact an administrator ({{code}}).
issues.failed: Indexing failed ({{code}}). Check the file and retry, or upload a corrected version.

abilities.title: Abilities
abilities.subtitle: Manage personal assistants and inspect assistants shared with you. Runtime and model details stay managed by the workspace.
abilities.name: Name
abilities.packageHint: Select one folder containing exactly one SKILL.md. Companion files are imported with their relative paths and binary contents preserved.
abilities.packageSkillFile: Choose one ability package folder containing exactly one SKILL.md.
abilities.packageImported: Ability package imported with {{count}} companion files.
abilities.linkedSkills: Skill packages available to this assistant

mcp.title: MCP connection
mcp.enterpriseAvailable: An enterprise connection is available with status {{status}}. A ready personal connection takes priority for your tasks.
mcp.credentialKeep: Leave blank to keep the saved credential
mcp.clearCredential: Clear the saved credential and disable this connection
mcp.saved: Connection saved. Run a test before using it.
mcp.testPassed: Connection passed in {{latency}} ms; {{count}} tools discovered.
mcp.testFailed: Connection test failed. Review the error and credential.
mcp.testHint: Save and test the connection to discover its tools.

abilities.linkedMcps: MCP connections available to this assistant
abilities.resourcesRefreshed: 승인된 리소스를 동기화했습니다. 실행 중인 작업은 현재 기능을 유지하고 새 작업부터 업데이트가 적용됩니다.
abilities.resourcesRefreshFailed: 승인된 리소스를 동기화하지 못했습니다({{code}}). 작업을 열지 않았습니다.
abilities.resourcesRefreshBusy: 작업이 실행 중이라 아직 기능을 새로 고칠 수 없습니다. 작업이 끝난 뒤 다시 새로 고치고 다음 작업부터 업데이트를 사용하세요.
abilities.packageBudgetWarning: Some skill packages exceeded the 48 MiB per-user runtime import budget and were skipped ({{issues}}). Other abilities and normal sign-in continue to work.
abilities.runtimeIssuesWarning: Some catalog abilities are unavailable in the current runtime ({{issues}}). Enabled here means authorized and configured; review these runtime issues before use.

memory.title: Memory and schedules
memory.subtitle: Review and maintain information saved for future work. Scheduled tasks remain in the existing scheduler.
memory.scopeHint: Personal memory follows your account. Project memory applies only to the project ID you specify and is never promoted to enterprise scope automatically.
memory.deleteConfirm: This removes the selected saved memory.

preview.basicHint: 기본 미리보기입니다. 원본을 다운로드할 수 있습니다. Excel은 페이지당 100행, 최대 40열입니다. Word/PPT는 본문과 표를 표시합니다. 복잡한 서식, 이미지와 차트는 원본을 확인하세요. 최대 25MB.
preview.limitedHint: 일부 내용이 생략되거나 수식 {{count}}개를 다시 계산할 수 없습니다. 이전 값 대신 원래 수식을 표시합니다.
preview.configurationError: 설정이 준비되지 않았습니다({{code}}). 새로고침하거나 관리자에게 기본 모델, 도우미 및 기능을 확인해 달라고 요청하세요.
preview.busy: 다른 파일을 처리 중입니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도하세요.
preview.tooLarge: 미리보기 크기 제한을 초과했습니다. 원본을 다운로드하세요.
preview.timeout: 미리보기 시간이 초과되었습니다. 다시 시도하거나 원본을 다운로드하세요.
preview.failed: 미리보기 실패 ({{code}}). 다시 시도하거나 원본을 확인하세요.

delivery.retryPrompt: 기존 결과와 오류를 먼저 확인하고 미완성 또는 실패한 단계만 계속하세요. 완료된 결과를 다시 생성하지 마세요. 대상: {{paths}}
